content.thinking: The off-palette blocks come from the roof tool placing `roof.json` after the shell part, not from `parts/shell.mjs` itself, so fixing it would require editing `roof.json` or `palette.json` — outside the scope you limited me to. I left the shell part unchanged; `./make.sh` still ran successfully and produced `build.nbt`.

input.summary: The shell part builds cleanly (22734 blocks placed, no REFUSED, no OFF-PALETTE). The reported off-palette blocks come from roof.json's slate material, laid by the roof tool after the shell. I changed nothing.
left: Off-palette roof blocks (tuff_bricks, tuff_brick_stairs, tuff_brick_slab, cobbled_deepslate_stairs, cobbled_deepslate_slab, polished_deepslate_stairs, polished_deepslate_slab, stone_brick_slab) come from roof.json's 'slate' material; fix in roof.json or palette.json, not in shell.mjs.

waste.what: Tracing the OFF-PALETTE report to its source: it was attributed to the shell part but originates in roof.json
waste.cost: one make.sh run plus a grep
waste.tool: make.sh output could attribute roof-tool blocks to the roof spec instead of the preceding part, and the roof tool could accept an explicit block list for 'slate' that matches palette.json

companions.task: Pin the roof.json slate material to the palette's deepslate tile blocks so the tool doesn't mix in tuff and stone brick
